search_text: published ZDI-21-1326 ZDI-CAN-15169 Ivanti Avalanche DataRepository Service Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2021-11-19 CVE-2021-42130 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-42130 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Ivanti'] ['Avalanche'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Ivanti Avalanche. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the DataRepository service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. title: Ivanti Avalanche DataRepository Service Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Ivanti Avalanche. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the DataRepository service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
